petronas.name: Petronas Towers
petronas.price_text: ≈ MYR 80–120 for the observation deck; check on the day
petronas.hours: Observation deck Tue–Sun roughly 09:00–21:00 · closed Monday
petronas.tip: Book a timed slot online and go at dusk to see the city lights come on.

batu.name: Batu Caves
batu.price_text: Free · small fee for some cave areas
batu.tip: Come before 09:00 to climb the 272 steps before the heat and crowds. Cover shoulders and knees.

merdeka_square.name: Merdeka Square
merdeka_square.tip: Walk the lawn and the colonial buildings around it in the cooler early evening.

kl_tower.name: KL Tower
kl_tower.price_text: ≈ MYR 50–80 for the observation deck; check on the day
kl_tower.tip: The outdoor skydeck gives better photos than the glass box. Go near sunset.

thean_hou.name: Thean Hou Temple
thean_hou.tip: Climb to the upper terrace for city views, and visit during Chinese New Year for lanterns.

islamic_arts.name: Islamic Arts Museum Malaysia
islamic_arts.tip: The model mosques and jewellery galleries are the highlights. Air-conditioned and calm.
islamic_arts.best: Midday, when it is hottest outside

merdeka_118.name: Merdeka 118
merdeka_118.price_text: Observation deck pricing varies; check on the day
merdeka_118.tip: The world's second-tallest building. View it from Merdeka Square or the KL Tower area.

national_mosque.name: National Mosque of Malaysia
national_mosque.price_text: Free · robes lent at the entrance
national_mosque.hours: Open to visitors outside prayer times; check on the day
national_mosque.tip: Dress modestly; robes are provided. Avoid the main prayer times.

bukit_bintang.name: Bukit Bintang
bukit_bintang.tip: The shopping and street-food heart of the city. Walk Jalan Bukit Bintang after dark.

aquaria.name: Aquaria KLCC
aquaria.tip: Good rainy-day option with kids. The underwater tunnel is the highlight.

times_square.name: Berjaya Times Square Theme Park
times_square.tip: Indoor rides for families. Check ride closures before you buy tickets.

bukit_jalil.name: Bukit Jalil National Stadium
bukit_jalil.tip: Only worth the trip for a match or concert. Check the event calendar first.

jalan_alor.name: Jalan Alor
jalan_alor.price_text: ≈ MYR 15–50 per person for a meal
jalan_alor.tip: Come hungry after dark and try grilled seafood and satay. Bring cash.

kidzania.name: KidZania Kuala Lumpur
kidzania.tip: Best for children roughly 4–12. Book online and go early.

murugan.name: Lord Murugan Statue
murugan.hours: With the Batu Caves temple, roughly 06:00–21:00
murugan.tip: The tall golden statue stands at the foot of the Batu Caves steps. Combine the two visits.

masjid_jamek.name: Masjid Jamek
masjid_jamek.price_text: Free · robes lent at the entrance
masjid_jamek.hours: Open outside prayer times; check on the day
masjid_jamek.tip: One of the oldest mosques in the city, at the meeting of two rivers. Dress modestly.

nasi_lemak.name: Nasi Lemak
nasi_lemak.hours: Varies by stall; many open breakfast to late
nasi_lemak.tip: Malaysia's national dish: rice cooked in coconut milk with sambal, egg and peanuts. Try it for breakfast.

pasar_seni.name: Pasar Seni
pasar_seni.tip: Central Market for crafts and souvenirs. Good for gifts on a rainy afternoon.

petaling_street.name: Petaling Street Market
petaling_street.price_text: Free to walk · food and goods priced per stall
petaling_street.tip: Chinatown's busy market street. Haggle politely and watch your bag.

putra_mosque.name: Putra Mosque
putra_mosque.price_text: Free · robes lent at the entrance
putra_mosque.hours: Open outside prayer times; check on the day
putra_mosque.tip: The pink mosque in Putrajaya, about 40 minutes from the city. Combine with a Putrajaya day trip.

sri_mahamariamman.name: Sri Mahamariamman Temple
sri_mahamariamman.tip: The oldest Hindu temple in the city, near Chinatown. Remove shoes before entering.

sunway_lagoon.name: Sunway Lagoon
sunway_lagoon.tip: Water park and rides outside the city centre. Bring swimwear and a change of clothes.

klcc_park.name: KLCC Park
klcc_park.tip: Best free view of the Petronas Towers. Come at dusk for the fountain show.

night_food_tour.name: Evening street-food walk
night_food_tour.price_text: ≈ MYR 80–180 per person; check on the day
night_food_tour.tip: A guided walk through Jalan Alor and nearby stalls. Confirm food and drinks are included.

river_walk.name: Klang River walk
river_walk.tip: Follow the river between Masjid Jamek and Merdeka Square for murals and old buildings.

brickfields_walk.name: Brickfields Little India walk
brickfields_walk.price_text: Free to walk · food priced per stall
brickfields_walk.tip: Walk the streets near the KL Sentral area for Indian food, spices and banana-leaf meals.

helipad_view.name: Rooftop bar city view
helipad_view.tip: A rooftop drink gives the best skyline view for the price. Dress smart-casual.
